headline: Approved 2026 Park Manor rent increase, a 4% raise for non-union staff, and a two-year extension of attorney Joseph Brennan's contract.
summary: The meeting covered monthly department reports, the minutes of June 17 and August 18, 2026, and two union contracts. The board approved the union contracts, a two-year extension of Joseph Brennan, Esq.'s contract, and the 2026 Park Manor rent increase. It also approved a 4% salary increase for non-union personnel.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the June 17, 2026 meeting, 5-0.
Approved the minutes of the August 18, 2026 meeting, 5-0.
Approved the Local Union 1217 Laborers Collective Bargaining Agreement, 5-0.
Approved the Local Union 251 Teamsters Collective Bargaining Agreement, 5-0.
Approved a two-year extension of Joseph Brennan, Esq.’s contract, 5-0.
Accepted the consent agenda of department reports, 5-0.
Accepted the Executive and Deputy Director’s report as read by individual commissioners.
Approved Resolution #1427, the 2026 Park Manor rent increase, 5-0.
Approved a 4% salary increase for non-union personnel, with all present voting in favor.

THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
 
 
BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS MEETING 
 
Galego Court 
Community Room  
483 Weeden Street 
Pawtucket, RI 02860 
 
September 10, 2026, at 4:00 P.M. 
 
AGENDA MINUTES 
 
 
1. Meeting called to Order 
 
2. Roll Call 
 
3. Resident and Public Concerns on Agenda Items only 
*All public comments will be limited to three (3) minutes per person to speak. Time 
cannot be yielded to others. Time is allocated for the Board to listen; they will not 
engage in discussion. 
 
4. Approval and VOTE of Minutes from June 17, 2026, and August 18, 2026 
 
5. Executive Session (R. I. General Laws section 42-46-5(a)(2)) – Discussion 
and/or Approval and Vote on: 
• Local Union 1217 Laborers Collective Bargaining Agreement 
• Local Union 251 Teamsters Collective Bargaining Agreement 
6. Correspondences – Discussion, Approval and Vote 
 
• Legal Contract Agreement with Joseph Brennan, Esq. 
 
7. Executive & Deputy Directors Monthly Report – Report by Executive & Deputy 
Directors to the Board concerning major ongoings of the PHA since the last Board 
meeting. 
 
8. Approval and Vote of the Consent Agenda - All Department Reports
THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
 
 
• (6A) Leased Housing Report – Report summarizes the monthly activities within 
the Housing Choice Voucher Program. 
• (6B) Public Housing Report - Report discusses the status of occupancy, 
inspections, annual recertifications, application count, move ins, move outs, and 
calculation of occupancy formula for the previous month. 
• (6C) Legal Status Report – Report concerning the status of evictions and other 
ongoing legal proceedings. 
• (6D) Financial Report – Report reviews the prior month’s finances for all 
departments. 
• (6E) Security Report – Report highlights all monthly Security activity that occurred 
within the PHA. 
• (6F) Resident Services Report – Report discusses grants being applied for, 
resident events occurring and attendance at previous events, as well as some 
highlights from each Resident Services Program that is offered. 
• (6G) Other Non-Public Housing Report - Report discusses the status of 
occupancy, inspections, annual recertifications, application count, move ins, 
move outs, and calculation of occupancy formula for the previous month. 
• (6H) Facilities and Capital Projects Report – Report covers any scheduled 
operating work-related activities or current capital improvements. 
 
9. New Business  
 
• None 
 
Resolutions – Discussion, Approval and Vote on the following resolutions: 
 
• Resolution #1427- Approval of 2026 Park Manor Rent Increase 
 
 
10. Other Business 
 
 
Executive Session (R. I. General Laws section 42-46-5(a)(1)& (a)(2)) – Discussion 
and/or Approval and Vote on: 
 
• Non-Union Personnel  
• Deputy and Executive Director Contract 
 
Adjournment – Vote 
 
Next Meeting: Kennedy Manor, Community Room, Wednesday, October 21, 2026, 
at 4 pm.
THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
 
 
The Meeting was called to order by Mary Bray, Chairperson of the Board at 4:01 pm 
with a motion made by Commissioner Rabbitt and seconded by Commissioner Kelley.
